import pathlib, sys, json

raw = pathlib.Path('baseline_frozen.yaml').read_text(encoding='utf-8')

# Show the raw reference_checks section as written in the baseline
lines = raw.splitlines()
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if 'reference_checks' in line:
        print('--- raw section starting at line %d ---' % i)
        for j in range(i, min(i + 45, len(lines))):
            print('%3d: %s' % (j, lines[j]))
        break

print()
print('--- parsed structure ---')
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import model
cfg = model.parse_simple_yaml(raw)
entries = cfg.get('reference_checks')
print('type:', type(entries).__name__, 'len:', len(entries) if hasattr(entries, '__len__') else 'n/a')
if isinstance(entries, list):
    for k, e in enumerate(entries):
        print('entry', k, 'type', type(e).__name__, ':', json.dumps(e, default=str)[:300])
print()
print('baseline sha256:', __import__('hashlib').sha256(pathlib.Path('baseline_frozen.yaml').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
